info.name: Vidu API
info.description: Generative video AI from Shengshu Technology. Create-then-poll: submit a generation task, then poll /tasks/{id}/creations for the finished video. Auth is 'Authorization: Token vda_xxx'.

body.data:
{
  "model": "viduq3-turbo",
  "prompt": "a red fox running through a snowy forest at dawn",
  "duration": 5,
  "resolution": "720p",
  "aspect_ratio": "16:9"
}

items.docs: Generate a video from a text prompt. Returns an async task_id to poll.
